method: Rendered every PDF page at 64 dpi and inspected five 4-by-4 contact sheets
Inspected the line-start-punctuation candidates at larger size
Checked cover, front matter, TOC, text pages, figure pages, glossary and final page
notes: The PDF text extractor reports punctuation that is visually hung at the previous line edge as if it began the next extracted line; rendered-page inspection did not confirm those candidates.
No blank overflow page or extreme-whitespace text-only page remains.
Image-heavy pages intentionally retain white space so the historical plate and its reading note remain together.
